leads.summary: Machina Labs was selected under the US Department of War’s Organic Industrial Base Modernization Challenge to develop and qualify a metal airframe for the Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (LUCAS) class. Machina Bellator will lead development and qualification in Los Angeles, while each pilot site will start with a containerized robotic manufacturing cell.

leads.title: Meet the defense company that’s gotten the Pentagon’s attention
leads.summary: The Pentagon ordered 8,000 Neros Archer 5-inch and 6,000 Archer AI drones after the company finished in the top five of both components of the Drone Dominance Gauntlet II exercise at Fort Carson, Colorado. The Pentagon’s Office of Strategic Capital also agreed to give Neros a $450 million loan to help expand production and make supply chains more domestically based.

stories.title: US Army evaluates the FD-1 interceptor’s C-UAS capabilities in Europe
stories.summary: The United States Army conducted an internal assessment of the FD-1 interceptor’s counter-uncrewed aerial systems capabilities at the Ustka Training Area in Poland from 2-6 November. Operation Audacious Fury aimed to establish cost-effective, lower-tier kinetic magazine depth against Group 1–3 and massed UAS threats.

also.title: U.S. Army Air Defenders In Europe Assess C-UAS Interceptor

stories.title: AutoFlight Completes Five-Aircraft Autonomous eVTOL Formation Flight
Airspeeder Names eVTOL Pilots for International Series Line-up
UBTECH Partners with Tianyi to Scale Humanoid Robot Adoption
stories.summary: UBTECH and Tianyi Telecom Terminal signed a strategic cooperation agreement on November 9, 2026, aiming to help the household-companion robot-terminal industry exceed one million units within three years. The partnership also targets more than 100,000 ultra-bionic humanoid and wheeled humanoid terminals, combining China Telecom’s channel network with UBTECH’s robot technology.

stories.title: Appetronix brings robotic dining to airports
stories.summary: Appetronix launched Donatos by Appetronix, a fully autonomous restaurant at John Glenn Columbus International Airport that uses robotic food preparation and heated pickup lockers to serve travelers around the clock. The company was selected as one of 10 Automated Retail & Kiosk Innovation Award winners for 2026, with winners to be honored at the show in Miami Beach from Dec. 14-16.

stories.title: West Valley Votes on Free Police Drone Trial With $874,985 Renewal
stories.summary: The West Valley City Council votes Tuesday, November 10, on a deal with Motorola Solutions that would give the Utah city’s police department three BRINC drones for a year at no cost. The package covers a docked drone dispatched directly to calls, a tactical drone officers launch from their vehicles, and a small indoor drone for SWAT work.

stories.title: After Fort Worth, Tesla launches Robotaxi Service in San Antonio, Texas today (Nov 9) — now available in 8 cities
Florida university selects electric eVTOL for police patrol role
stories.summary: Florida Polytechnic University in Lakeland, Florida, introduced a Jetson ONE electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft for evaluation in law enforcement operations. The university intends to assess the aircraft for campus patrols and emergency supplies, with police officers receiving pilot training.

stories.title: Oshkosh Defense to produce Grid Aero's Lifter long-range cargo drone to improve US military logistics
stories.summary: Oshkosh Defense partnered with Grid Aero on November 2, 2026, to manufacture the Lifter autonomous cargo drone in Wisconsin, marking Oshkosh’s first entry into aircraft production. The initial Lifter Lite targets a 2,000-lb payload over 2,000 nautical miles, with a pilot line targeted for late 2027 to support U.S. military logistics in the Indo-Pacific.

stories.title: RLWRLD secures investment from Nvidia to advance robot AI technology
stories.summary: RLWRLD confirmed on Nov. 9 that Nvidia will invest in the physical AI startup to upgrade its robotics foundation model and broaden industrial deployment. The company also unveiled DexBench, a benchmark for evaluating humanoid robots' precise hand manipulation capabilities across 15 tasks in four industrial environments.

stories.title: AI and Robotics Expanding Warehouse Capacity
Safran and MSI-DS Partner on Next-Gen Counter-Drone Naval Turrets
stories.summary: Safran Electronics & Defense and MSI-Defence Systems signed a Memorandum of Understanding to integrate Safran optronic sights into MSI-Defence Systems’ SEAHAWK naval gun systems. Under an initial contract for a European NATO navy, Safran will equip SEAHAWK DS30M 30 mm gun mounts aboard mine countermeasure vessels with VIGEO stabilized gunner sights, with deliveries scheduled for 2027.

stories.title: New international standard shifts autonomous vehicle safety burden to manufacturers, set for 2027 rollout
CSG Delivers Digital Backbone for Drone Operations in Czech Airspace
stories.summary: UpVision delivered the CIS+ system to Air Navigation Services of the Czech Republic to serve as a digital backbone for U-space operations. The platform enables real-time coordination between drones and conventional air traffic by sharing airspace restrictions, flight authorizations, and meteorological data.

also.title: CSG to support the implementation of U-space in Czech airspace

stories.title: Russia’s New Geran-5 Drone Is Basically a Cruise Missile—and It’s Packed With Foreign Electronics
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence Directorate (HUR) identified 93 foreign-made electronic components in a new Geran-5 K5-K drone, which it classifies as a small cruise missile. Russian forces began using the variant to strike Ukrainian cities in early autumn 2026, and the drone now exceeds 450 km/h cruising speed with a maximum altitude of 6 kilometers.

also.title: Russia turns Geran-5 drone into a mini cruise missile: Ukraine reveals new specs
Russian Geran-5 drone operates like miniature cruise missile — HUR

stories.title: Embodied AI unveils AIR, a wheeled humanoid robot designed to work beside factory staff
stories.summary: Lausanne-based Embodied AI unveiled AIR, a wheeled humanoid robot with light, tendon-driven arms, at Humanoid Europe 2026 in Munich. The robot, designed under ISO/TS 15066 specifications, is being tested by major manufacturers and reached 98% reliability on a cable-handling task.

also.title: New wheeled humanoid robot learns factory jobs in a month, reports 95% success rate

stories.title: Robots from around the world enter the 'production line' ... factories become a battleground for humanoids
stories.summary: Global robotics companies including U.S. firms Tesla and Figure AI and China's UBTech Robotics Inc. are expanding their efforts to enter manufacturing. Tesla has begun initial production of its humanoid robot Optimus at its factory in Fremont, California.

stories.title: NXP Unveils Unified Robotics Platform to Speed Trusted Physical AI Deployment
stories.summary: NXP Semiconductors announced a unified robotics platform on Nov. 09, 2026, that integrates sensing, control, and AI processing to reduce development time from months to days. The platform includes drone reference designs that deliver initial functionality within 30 minutes, with additional autonomous system support expected in 2H 2027.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces Set New Record, Hitting 801 Russian Troops in 24 Hours
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces struck 801 Russian troops on November 8, killing 281 and wounding 520. The units destroyed 959 of 2,611 targets using 5,217 strike sorties.

also.title: Ukraine’s Drone Forces Set New Record With 801 Russian Troops Eliminated or Wounded in One Day

stories.title: NATO & NCIA’s Counter-Drone Marketplace Speeds Procurement
stories.summary: NATO launched a counter-drone marketplace managed by the NATO Communications and Information Agency to allow member states to directly procure systems, bypassing complex tender processes. The initiative, part of a US$40 billion Drone Edge program, features 16 pre-assessed solutions from five suppliers, including Alta Ares, Northrop Grumman, OSL UK, Axon, and Quantum Systems.

also.title: NATO Counter-Drone Catalog: 2024 Startup Says It Won 6 of 16 Lots
NATO Drone Defense: Alta Ares Secures Six Contracts

stories.title: New Middle East Counter Drone Order (US$16M)
stories.summary: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited secured a US$16 million contract for counter-drone defence systems with the Armed Forces of a Middle Eastern nation state. The order, which includes sensor systems and the MARSS NiDAR C2 system, is expected to be substantially delivered in the next 12 months.

also.title: EOS secures counter-drone defence systems contract with Middle East armed forces customer

stories.title: Ukraine Hits 78.6% Jet-Drone Intercept Rate; Russia Mounts Jammers, Cuts Power to 1 Million
stories.summary: Ukraine's Air Force shot down or electronically suppressed 88 of 112 jet-powered Shaheds in Russia's November 7–8 attack, achieving a preliminary 78.6% intercept rate. The strike left more than a million consumers without electricity and killed at least seven people, while Ukraine-Russia-U.S. peace negotiations in Abu Dhabi are scheduled to begin in 48 hours.

stories.title: NASA is building a car-sized, nuclear-powered drone to fly on Saturn’s moon Titan, because air about four times as dense as Earth’s and a seventh of the gravity make flying there easier than flying here
stories.summary: NASA is building Dragonfly, a car-sized, nuclear-powered octocopter scheduled to launch in July 2028 and reach Titan in 2034. The $3.35 billion mission will visit 20 to 30 sites over more than three years, using a Multi-Mission Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator to power its science laboratory.

stories.title: Reframing drone defence: The Korea Herald
stories.summary: South Korea launched the Defense Drone Agency on Monday to replace the Drone Operations Command, which was dissolved amid controversy over its alleged role in the martial law declaration of Dec. 3, 2024. The new headquarters, staffed by about 100 personnel, will oversee policy and support drone development and acquisition, while the Joint Chiefs of Staff will coordinate operations.

stories.title: Why did Latvia's military fail to shoot down the drone? Defence Minister explains failure and apologises to residents
stories.summary: Latvia's Defence Minister Raivis Melnis shortened the decision-making chain for drone interception teams to enable faster responses after failing to shoot down a drone last week. He removed additional safeguards, granted ground teams greater authority, and deployed extra radar systems along the eastern border to improve detection and response times.

stories.title: Second Woodley railway bridge to close as major rail works continue
stories.summary: Network Rail will close the bridge on Butts Hill Road in Woodley from Monday, November 9, until mid-January 2027 to stabilise a railway cutting near Sonning. Pedestrians will still be able to use the bridge, although cyclists will need to dismount.

stories.title: Iran's Insane Move Against US Drones! Yak-130 Reportedly Rammed American UAV
stories.summary: An Iranian Air Force Yak-130 reportedly rammed and destroyed an American reconnaissance drone after an R-73 missile failed to hit its target during the 2026 conflict. The Congressional Research Service assessed that American forces lost or damaged at least 50 unmanned aircraft, including 45 MQ-9 Reapers, in the campaign that began on February 28, 2026.

stories.title: World rail contract news round-up
stories.summary: Göteborg’s municipal transport operator donated the first of a fleet of M29 trams to Mykolaiv, Ukraine. The article also notes that Renfe indefinitely postponed its expansion to Paris and recalled its Talgo Avril test fleet, jeopardizing the approval program for French start-up Le Train.

stories.title: PM Modi Flags Off Four New Vande Bharat Express Trains From Varanasi
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off four new Vande Bharat Express trains from Varanasi on November 8, 2025, connecting Khajuraho, Saharanpur, Firozpur, Delhi, Ernakulam and Bengaluru. The launch brought the total number of operational Vande Bharat trains in India to over 160.

stories.title: [Forum] No compromise on autonomous vehicle safety
stories.summary: The Land Transport Authority ordered Grab to suspend testing at such junctions pending the completion of investigations after a Grab autonomous vehicle nearly hit a girl crossing the road at a Punggol junction.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Russia's second-largest oil refinery in overnight drone attack
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Russia's second-largest oil refinery in Kirishi, Leningrad Oblast, on Nov. 9, causing large explosions and multiple hotspots detected by NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System. Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said 113 Ukrainian drones were shot down over the region during the attack.

also.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russia’s Second-Largest Oil Refinery; Moscow Says 81 UAVs Downed
Ukraine Strikes Russia’s Second-Largest Oil Refinery as 113 Drones Hit Leningrad Region

stories.title: South Korea aims to master core robotics technology and has room for cooperation with Vietnam.
stories.summary: The South Korean government announced a plan to invest 2.3 trillion won by 2030 to develop a humanoid robot ecosystem, with an estimated budget of 600 billion won in 2027. The initiative aims to increase the localization rate of core components from approximately 45% to 80% and purchase 1,080 robots by 2030.

stories.title: Reaper Drone 491 mph Claim: Student Jet, Unverified [2026]
stories.summary: Georgia Tech student Tomas Salvo claims his jet-powered model aircraft, Reaper, reached 491 mph (790 km/h) while carrying a 1.2 kg payload. The article notes that no sanctioned timing gates, official observers, or Guinness World Records certification exist for the result.

stories.title: Kaduna-Kano Rail Line Ready For December 3 Inauguration
stories.summary: The All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council announced the Kaduna-Kano Standard Gauge Railway will be inaugurated on December 3, 2026, with the 203-kilometre line 90 per cent complete. The 400-kilometre Kano-Katsina-Maradi railway is 70 per cent complete, and President Bola Ahmed Tinubu directed immediate resolution of land acquisition issues in Kaduna metropolis.

stories.title: Nvidia robotics chief calls Korea key to physical AI, highlights partnerships with Hyundai, Doosan, SK and LG
stories.summary: Nvidia Vice President Deepu Talla announced expanded physical AI collaborations with Hyundai Motor Group, Doosan, SK hynix, and LG Electronics at the Nvidia AI Day Seoul 2026 event. The partnerships focus on applying AI to manufacturing sites, including robot simulations for automotive production lines and digital twins of semiconductor factories.

also.title: NVIDIA expands its “physical AI” reach with Samsung, SK and LG—from semiconductor research to robot trials

stories.title: Drone Statistics 2026: Registrations, Pilots and Commercial Fleets
stories.summary: The FAA issued more than 493,000 remote pilot certifications as of December 2025, while its nonrecreational registry held 424,516 active aircraft. The agency forecasts the commercial drone fleet to exceed one million by the end of 2025 and grow to 1.18 million by 2029.

stories.title: Renault unveils autonomous electric ground vehicle concept Forefront
stories.summary: Renault Group unveiled the Forefront unmanned ground vehicle concept co-developed with John Cockerill, a modular platform designed for French Army missions and civilian high-risk environments. The companies plan to deploy the vehicle in multiple training sessions and field tests in the coming weeks to validate and refine the concept in real operating environments.

also.title: Renault develops autonomous military vehicle concept with John Cockerill

stories.title: Ultra-large autonomous underwater vehicles set to be built with $38 million new funding
stories.summary: Corridian, a New England-based defense technology startup, emerged from stealth with a $38 million seed funding round led by Point72 Ventures to develop ultra-large autonomous underwater vehicles. The company plans to unveil its flagship vehicle in 2027, which is designed to carry ISO-standard, containerized payloads across thousands of nautical miles without a crew.

stories.title: I've surrendered to LA's robot invasion after discovering an unexpected pleasure in the back seat
stories.summary: Waymo expanded service to the South Bay, bringing its sleek white Jaguars to Torrance, El Segundo, and Manhattan Beach. The robotaxi company, owned by Alphabet, started offering rides in LA in 2024.

stories.title: Vertaxi Shows M1 Manned eVTOL at 2026 CIIE in Shanghai; Fixed Passenger Routes Expected Around 2030
stories.summary: Vertaxi displayed its M1 manned eVTOL at the 2026 China International Import Expo in Shanghai, with the company expecting fixed passenger routes to open around 2030. The article notes that no launch city has been named and that certification status remains unstated.

stories.title: China robotaxi services spread but still require long walk to pickup points
stories.summary: Pony.ai's second-quarter robotaxi service revenue rose 691.2 percent from a year earlier to $12.1 million. As of the end of June, it had 1,975 vehicles in operation, and by mid-August registered users in China had topped 1.5 million.

stories.title: JSK’s 3D-Printed Robot Leg Muscles
stories.summary: Researchers from the University of Tokyo’s JSK Robotics Laboratory built a new type of robotic leg using 3D-printed plastic for bones and thermoplastic polyurethane for artificial muscles, tendons, ligaments, and cushioning. The legs measure 95 cm (3 feet 1 inch) and demonstrated repeated stepping movements at strides of up to 80 cm (2 feet 7 inches).

stories.title: University of Huddersfield joins £3.67m robotics project to help local manufacturers automate
stories.summary: The University of Huddersfield joined the Yorkshire Robotics Adoption Hub, a £3.67 million project led by the University of Bradford to help manufacturers introduce robotics and automation. The hub secured £2.75 million from Innovate UK and aims to work with more than 300 manufacturers across Yorkshire over 42 months.

stories.title: Royal Navy launches its first autonomous squadron of uncrewed boats
stories.summary: The Royal Navy launched its first autonomous squadron on Thursday, basing 180 personnel at Portsmouth Naval Base to operate Rattler and Kraken K3 Scout boats. The initiative is part of a hybrid navy strategy with £1.5 billion earmarked over four years.

New Royal Navy drone boats to intercept Russian warships and spy vessels in UK waters

stories.title: Skydio Controller 2 Ships: Bigger Screen, More Runtime, 395 g Heavier
stories.summary: Skydio’s Controller 2, a new handheld controller for its X10, X10D and R10 drones, is going out to customers, CEO Adam Bry posted on LinkedIn on Sunday, November 8. Skydio had announced it on October 27 with a 7-inch screen rated at 2,000 nits sustained and more than 5 hours 45 minutes of battery life.

stories.title: Counter-Drone Capability Isn’t Determined by Technology Alone
stories.summary: Counter-drone capability requires managing a site-specific ecosystem rather than relying solely on technology, as geography, RF environments, and local regulations dictate optimal sensor placement and mitigation options. Effective deployments must integrate with existing security workflows and maintain operator proficiency through ongoing training and software updates to counter evolving drone threats.

stories.title: Chinese Drone Swarm Maps Woods on Its Own, and Withholds the Code
stories.summary: Tongji University researchers published a paper in Autonomous Intelligent Systems on December 22, 2025, describing the ESCAPE framework, which allows three to four lidar-equipped quadcopters to autonomously map indoor and outdoor areas without a ground station. The authors withheld the code from public release due to confidentiality requirements, while the paper notes the drones avoided collisions using on-board risk scoring and pairwise cell exchanges.

stories.title: Turo Launches Full Self-Driving Tesla Rentals for US Users
stories.summary: Turo announced that beginning October 28, 2026, guests across the United States will have the ability to specifically filter and book Tesla vehicles equipped with verified Full Self-Driving (FSD) capabilities. The platform will utilize a new verification layer that confirms the active status of the FSD package on the specific vehicle identification number (VIN) provided by the host.

also.title: A2Z Launches First Self-Driving Bus in Japanese Hot Spring Town

stories.title: Haiti's Drone War Claims a Gang Leader, and Two Death Stories
stories.summary: Haiti’s prime minister, Alix Didier Fils-Aimé, confirmed the death of Mathias Saintil, the leader of the Boston gang in Cité Soleil, on Friday, November 6, following coordinated police operations that deployed at least seven kamikaze drones across five communes of Port-au-Prince. The National Human Rights Defense Network states a drone struck Saintil’s home and vehicle, while the Haiti National Police claims he was struck by multiple gunshots during a police operation.

stories.title: Iran Never Sent Drones to California. The Barksdale Case Is Still Open
stories.summary: The FBI warned California police in late February that Iran had “allegedly aspired” to launch drones at the state from a ship off the coast, but no Iranian drone has reached the United States. The White House called the Iran story false the day after it ran, and no agency has publicly said who flew the Barksdale drones.

stories.title: Chimp Sanctuary Fed Kaleb by DJI Drone. Florida Agencies Can't Fly One
Amazon's MK30 Hangs in Seattle's Museum of Flight. It Still Flies
stories.summary: The Museum of Flight in Seattle hung an Amazon Prime Air MK30 delivery drone from the ceiling of its T.A. Wilson Great Gallery this week. The aircraft, which Amazon flies to customers in 13 US metros, joins the museum’s Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles exhibit alongside a German V-1 and the Lockheed Martin RQ-3A DarkStar.

stories.title: Mar-a-Lago Gets the Laser Family Behind El Paso's Airspace Shutdown
stories.summary: NORAD and U.S. Northern Command deployed a 20-kilowatt AeroVironment LOCUST counter-drone laser around Mar-a-Lago at the request of the U.S. Secret Service. The system, mounted on a Joint Light Tactical Vehicle, sits three miles from a commercial runway within a one-nautical-mile restricted airspace that has been in place since October 2025.

also.title: AeroVironment LOCUST Counter-Drone Laser Spotted at Mar-a-Lago as NORAD Confirms Air Defense Deployment

stories.title: Pentagon Counts 300 Border Drone Defeats. Two Were Publicly Identified
stories.summary: Joint Task Force-Southern Border said in September it had defeated more than 300 drones along the US-Mexico border this year, 11 of them with the AMP-HEL laser. Since February, the targets of only two engagements have been identified in public: a set of Mylar party balloons over El Paso and a CBP drone.

stories.title: America's New Counter-Drone Weapon Bumblebee V2 Is Heading to the Border
stories.summary: The US military is evaluating the Bumblebee V2, a kinetic interceptor developed by Perennial Autonomy, with Army Rangers. Backed by a Pentagon contract worth up to $500 million, the system could help protect military installations, critical infrastructure and the US southern border.

stories.title: Tesla's FSD (Supervised) Attach Rate Hit 75% on New Vehicles. Here's Why That Single Number Could Matter More Than Robotaxi for the Stock in 2027.
stories.summary: Tesla reported that more than 75% of its new vehicle deliveries in North America included a paid Full Self-Driving (Supervised) subscription sign-up in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of nearly 20 percentage points from the previous quarter. The company ended the quarter with approximately 1.74 million active paid FSD customers worldwide, up from 1.48 million in the second quarter, with about half of those customers using monthly subscriptions rather than paying up front.

stories.title: AGCO, Agility Robotics plan humanoid robot pilot at Kansas plant
stories.summary: AGCO and Agility Robotics signed a commercial agreement to introduce artificial intelligence-powered humanoid robots into manufacturing operations. The United States pilot, expected to begin in 2027, will support AGCO’s efforts to create more flexible and automated factories, beginning at AGCO’s Hesston, Kansas, production facility.

stories.title: ​Poland Won't Receive First San Anti-Aircraft Guns in Time to Counter russian Drone Threat
stories.summary: The Polish Ministry of Defense stated that deliveries of 18 San air defense batteries, ordered in January 2026 for PLN 15 billion, will begin in 2027 rather than the end of 2026. The delay stems from the Skyview software, which integrates the system's components, not being ready.

stories.title: Autonomous shuttle almost hits oncoming vehicle in Punggol Field while making U-turn
stories.summary: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) directed ComfortDelGro to pause U-turns at a Punggol Field junction after an autonomous shuttle nearly hit an oncoming vehicle on Nov. 5. LTA is investigating the incident, which occurred while ComfortDelGro tested a new route for its enhanced on-demand service.

stories.title: Ukrainian Forces Strike Four Russian Drone Command Posts, Including One Linked to Rubicon Center
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck four Russian drone command posts in temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories and Russia’s Bryansk region. The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reported the strikes, including a target in Berdiansk, Zaporizhzhia region, linked to a unit of Russia’s Rubicon Center.

also.title: Ukraine Strikes Four Russian Drone Command Posts, Including Elite Rubikon Unit Base
Ukrainian forces strike four drone ground control stations in Russia and occupied territories

stories.title: Japan Earthquake Disrupts Shinkansen and Airport Rail Links
stories.summary: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck western Shizuoka Prefecture at 1:04 a.m. on November 8, causing JR Central to impose speed restrictions on the Tokaido Shinkansen and suspend Meitetsu services to Chubu Centrair International Airport. The Japan Meteorological Agency reported no tsunami threat but warned of potential aftershocks and landslides in the coming week.

stories.title: What Does Agility Robotics (AGLT) Gain From Its Expanded Humanoid Robot Rollout?
stories.summary: Agility Robotics and GXO Logistics expanded their partnership to roll out Digit humanoid robots across more logistics sites using a robots-as-a-service model. The first hard test arrives with planned Statesville and Lebanon deployments from early 2027, starting with Digit 4 and then shifting to Digit 5.

stories.title: Pocket-sized Ukrainian receiver intercepts Russian strike-drone video feeds from up to six miles away
stories.summary: Kyiv-based radio manufacturer CODE380 built the D·Vision SDR, a 10-ounce passive drone detector that intercepts analog video signals from Russian drones up to six miles away. The device scans frequencies from 500 MHz to 8.7 GHz, covering the 4.1 to 4.5 GHz band used by Russian Molniya strike drones since June 2026.

also.title: Pocket-sized Ukrainian receiver intercepts Russian strike drone video feeds up to six miles away — device only slightly heavier than a smartphone, intercepts analog video signals sent to Russian operators

stories.title: Suzuki-Backed Japanese eVTOL Gears Up for Commercial Service in South Korea
stories.summary: SkyDrive, Goyang Special City, and Verty will establish an ecosystem for flight trials and commercial eVTOL services in Goyang, with operations potentially starting in 2028. The Japanese company, backed by Suzuki Motor Corporation, recently received ADO certification from the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau and began type certification meetings with the FAA.

stories.title: DEEP Robotics Humanoid Robots Support Traffic Management at the 2026 Hangzhou Marathon
stories.summary: DEEP Robotics deployed humanoid robots at four locations around Huanglong Sports Center for the 2026 Hangzhou Marathon on November 1, supporting traffic management for 36,000 runners. The bipedal robot "Hangxing No. 2" performed intersection monitoring, autonomous patrols, and public assistance, allowing officers to focus on emergencies.

stories.title: Donation benefits Longview Fire Department’s drone program: Here’s how it will improve public safety
stories.summary: VeraBank presented the Longview Fire Department with a $50,000 check Friday to purchase a Skydio X10 drone for search and rescue, storm response, and other public safety operations. The drone features AI-powered autonomous flight, thermal imaging, and 64-megapixel zoom cameras, allowing firefighters to assess dangerous scenes from a safe distance.

stories.title: Houthis Claim attempted Riyadh Attack, Saudi Air Defenses Destroy Missiles and Drone
stories.summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed three Houthi ballistic missiles, two cruise missiles, and one drone targeting Riyadh and other regions. An Aramco administrative building in the King Abdullah Financial District was damaged by falling shrapnel, with no injuries or fatalities reported.

stories.title: Tada Enters Singapore Driverless Minibus Trial Starting in Early 2027

stories.summary: Pakistani private sector companies are seeking partnerships with American drone supplier Powerus to gain access to prototypes and potentially supply the global market. stories.summary: The US Navy is seeking a second-generation tactical resupply drone for the Marine Corps, requiring a fuel-powered or hybrid aircraft to carry 100 pounds of cargo for 40 nautical miles and return without refueling.

stories.summary: Wayanad environmental activists conditionally backed the proposed Kozhikode-Sulthan Bathery high-speed rail corridor after discussions with E Sreedharan. stories.summary: The federal government plans to introduce legislation to support accelerating the construction of the Alto high-speed rail project.

stories.title: Tesla forced to rename self-driving software and slash speed limits in Europe
stories.summary: RDW, the Netherlands' vehicle regulator, approved Tesla's renaming of FSD Supervised to Tesla Assisted Driving and reduced the maximum selectable speed margin from 50% to 10% above detected limits. The changes, distributed via over-the-air update, lower maximum speeds to 68 mph (110 km/h) in 62 mph (100 km/h) zones and 21 mph (33 km/h) in 19 mph (30 km/h) zones, with the margin resetting to 0% at vehicle start.

stories.title: Windracers ULTRA Makes History as First Autonomous Aircraft in Indiana Drone Corridor BVLOS Flight
stories.summary: Windracers completed a 50-mile autonomous flight in the Indiana drone corridor on October 29, 2026, during a ribbon-cutting ceremony at Terre Haute Indiana Airport attended by Governor Mike Braun, Senator Todd Young, and Representative Mark Messmer.

stories.title: Joby Aviation Targets Late-2026 Start for Dubai Air Taxi Service as Certified DXB Vertiport Is Ready but Operator Licence Is Pending
stories.summary: Joby Aviation plans to begin passenger air taxi operations in Dubai before the end of 2026, later than its original early-2026 target, and the start date could slip into early 2027. The main remaining approval is Joby's Air Operator Certificate from the General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA), which permits commercial air transport in the UAE.

Signature Aviation and UrbanV Form Signature UrbanV Alliance to Build U.S. Advanced Air Mobility Network
stories.summary: Signature Aviation and UrbanV formally established the Signature UrbanV Alliance to develop advanced air mobility infrastructure in the United States. The joint venture plans to integrate electric aircraft charging and passenger services into existing Signature terminals before expanding to dedicated vertiports.

stories.title: Canada to invest $1.8 billion in military drones
stories.summary: Canada plans to invest approximately $1.8 billion in military drones and counter-drone capabilities over the next five years, with funding beginning in the 2027–2028 fiscal year. The draft federal budget outlines priority areas including reconnaissance and strike drones, autonomous platforms, and low-cost air target interceptors.

stories.title: Orlando Airport Opens Air Taxi Pad at MCO: Plan Rides by 2030
stories.summary: Joby Aviation landed an electric air taxi at Orlando International Airport's new vertipad on Nov. 4, the first built on site at a U.S. commercial airport. The airport authority targets a commercial vertiport by 2030, with no passenger routes or fares set yet.

stories.title: Singapore regulator orders Grab to pause autonomous vehicle tests — Channel NewsAsia
stories.summary: Singapore's Land Transport Authority ordered Grab to suspend autonomous vehicle tests at certain intersections after a vehicle nearly hit a schoolgirl in Punggol. The regulator will assess whether vehicle responses should be adjusted, while Grab examines the incident with partner WeRide.

stories.title: SkyeBrowse turns one drone flight into a complete roof inspection
stories.summary: SkyeBrowse released a Roof Damage Analysis tool that uses AI to screen drone footage for damage and generate 3D roof measurements. The platform also added 2D map exports for GIS software and ground control point correction capabilities. These features are available on SkyeBrowse Pro models priced at $49.99 per model or $39.99 with annual billing.

stories.title: Drone Wars & Pilot Skills: Is US Military Training Outdated?
stories.summary: Sorian Aerospace plans to fly its autonomous supersonic trainer, the Sandman, in the Mojave Desert as early as Q1 next year to address outdated US military pilot training. The aircraft is designed for aggressor squadrons and supports manned-unmanned teaming, operating outside FAA Part 23 and Part 25 jurisdiction to allow rapid iteration.

stories.title: Flying Cars Are HERE: Joby Aviation on eVTOL Revolution [2025 Outlook]
stories.summary: Joby Aviation plans to launch commercial electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft service in New York City, Florida, and Texas under the federal eVTOL Integrated Pilot Program, with flying operations planned for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The company is permitted to conduct limited commercial operations ahead of full type certification and aims to begin replacing Blade Air Mobility helicopter trips with its own aircraft in the coming year.

stories.title: Flying Taxis & Cargo: Electric Aviation’s Future Takes Off
stories.summary: Beta Technologies secured FAA authorization for passenger flights in its electric VTOL aircraft and secured UPS as its largest single order holder. The company’s fixed-wing aircraft carries a 1,240-pound payload across 250 miles, enabling hub-bypass logistics that eliminate multi-stop routing for freight and time-critical medical cargo.

stories.summary: Manchester hosted discussions on a Wing Aviation proposal to bring Walmart drone delivery services to the community. Wing Manager Catherine Lovett presented the technology at a Nov. 4 open house, noting the company has completed more than 1 million residential deliveries and that drones can carry packages up to 2.75 pounds.

stories.title: French shipbuilder, Abu Dhabi institute team up on underwater drones
stories.summary: On Tuesday, November 3, French naval shipbuilder Naval Group and Abu Dhabi's Technology Innovation Institute (TII) signed an agreement to examine opportunities to jointly develop and commercialise uncrewed underwater vehicles (UUV). The cooperation will combine TII's capabilities in the XLUUV category with Naval Group's experience in unmanned underwater combat systems.

stories.title: STB signals broader protection for rail-served projects against state and local restrictions
stories.summary: The Surface Transportation Board issued a policy statement, final Nov. 9, that questions earlier decisions and identifies “strong policy arguments” for using categorical preemption when a taking would exclude rail use from a validly held right-of-way.

stories.title: Ukraine’s New Drone Scanner Lets Operators Watch Russian FPV Video Feeds in Real Time
stories.summary: Ukrainian developer December1 introduced the DroneSensor Providence, a radio-frequency scanner that intercepts real-time video feeds from FPV drones to support electronic warfare units. The system operates across 600 to 8,500 MHz with a 30-kilometer detection radius and routes targeting data directly to December1’s Damba jamming hardware. December1 currently produces hundreds of units monthly and plans to scale manufacturing to thousands per month by 2027.

stories.title: ABB Robotics Launches Blueprint For Physical AI Education At NVIDIA GTC Berlin
stories.summary: ABB Robotics developed an education program powered by NVIDIA AI technologies focused on physical AI to promote talent readiness. The program includes hands-on learning with ABB RobotStudio and NVIDIA Omniverse and provides a certificate in robotics, simulation and physical AI.

Russia builds massive drone launch base in months, capable of 100 launches per day
stories.summary: Russia transformed an empty field near the Millerovo military airfield into a large-scale attack drone launch base between August 8 and October 27, according to satellite images. The facility, intended for Geran-5 jet-powered drones, is expected to support up to 100 launches per day once construction is completed.

stories.title: NATO Speeds Up Counter-Drone Procurement
stories.summary: NATO launched the Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS) marketplace on Thursday (5 November 2026) to accelerate the acquisition of counter-drone technologies. The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) selected 16 solutions from five companies, and NATO allocated 3.1 million euros to fund further testing of these systems.

stories.title: UGV Laboratory is preparing the "Hyena" ground robot, with a range of 30 km, for mass production
stories.summary: UGV Laboratory unveiled three ground-based robotic systems from the "Hyena" family, including platforms for cargo delivery, combat missions, and remote weapon operation. The company is preparing the "Hyena" ground robot, with a range of 30 km, for mass production.

stories.title: Oasis Systems back at GAO challenging the Army's $665M counter drone contract
stories.summary: Oasis Systems filed a new protest on Nov. 5 challenging the Army's $665 million counter-unmanned aircraft systems contract awarded to Parsons Corp. The company argues the Army needs to rework the solicitation because it no longer reflects the service branch's needs, with a decision due Feb. 16.

stories.title: ​russian Sources Report Large-Scale Ukrainian Ground Robotic Assault Near Lyman
stories.summary: Russian Telegram channels reported that Ukraine's Third Army Corps deployed 28 ground robotic systems near Lyman in Donetsk region, including two equipped with Mk-19 automatic grenade launchers, 18 carrying two AT-4 anti-tank grenade launchers each, and eight configured as kamikaze drones.

stories.title: Royal Navy launches drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth amid push for tech 'with increased lethality'
stories.summary: The Royal Navy launched British-made Nyan Maritime one-way drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth in mid-October, marking the first strike drone launches from an aircraft carrier. These trials demonstrated how autonomous strike systems operate alongside F-35B stealth jets, supporting a government plan that allocates at least £210m for low-cost, long-range one-way attack drones by 2030.

stories.title: Physics and AI Could Improve Autonomous Vehicle Platooning
stories.summary: Researchers from Southeast University and Monash University developed a physics-informed platooning control framework that combines Model Predictive Control with learning-based optimization to improve vehicle stability and tracking accuracy. The study, published in Communications in Transportation Research, demonstrated that integrating physical models with artificial intelligence effectively reduces control errors caused by hardware uncertainties in real-world autonomous driving applications.

stories.title: US Air Force Commits Nearly $37M to Joby’s Autonomous Logistics Tech
stories.summary: Joby Aviation secured additional US Air Force funding to advance autonomous flight technology for military logistics, bringing the service's total commitment to nearly $37 million. The latest funding supports autonomy software development and expanded operational testing in the Pacific, following a coast-to-coast demonstration where the system handled autonomous taxiing, takeoffs, and landings across 24 states.

stories.title: The Dnipro, the impregnable river and military frontier between Ukrainian and Russian forces: ‘We’re in a war of drone pilots’
stories.summary: Ukrainian Marines from the 140th Intelligence Battalion launched Baton attack drones, costing around $3,300 each, from the Kherson region to contest Russian positions on the left bank of the Dnipro River. Unit leader Snake stated that the conflict has shifted from a 20th-century war to a 21st-century one, describing the current reality as a “war of drone pilots.”

stories.title: SNCF’s fifth generation of TGV enters passenger service
stories.summary: SNCF Voyageurs began carrying passengers on its first Alstom Avelia Horizon trainsets, branded TGV Nouvelle Génération, on November 6. The initial service ran from Paris to Marseille.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces carry out over 30,000 drone missions in single month for first time
stories.summary: Ukrainian defence forces carried out 31,398 logistics and evacuation missions using unmanned ground vehicles in October 2026, a record high since the beginning of the year. The Ministry of Defence stated that the number of tasks performed by these vehicles increased more than fourfold over the first ten months of 2026.

stories.summary: Atlantic Aviation launched a partnership with Electra to explore vertiport use in the New York City area under a memorandum of understanding signed Thursday.
